thread:
carlos: Metering alert from ACME — their March invoice shows 2.6x token usage vs what their SDK reported. They provided a minimal repro.

carlos: Repro steps:
1) SDK v0.12.3 local estimate (python) returned 1,420 tokens
2) API invoice shows 3,712 tokens charged
3) Payload includes system messages + toolcalls from sidecar

carlos: SDK snippet they used:
```py
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key='redacted')
resp = c.chat.create(model='rw-8b', messages=[{'role':'system','content':'You are terse.'},{'role':'user','content':prompt}])
print(resp.estimated_tokens)
```

amelia: Thanks — can you paste their exact HTTP request they sent to the API? Is streaming involved? any function/tool calls?

carlos: They used streaming via websocket and a sidecar that injects tool outputs server-side. Example curl they gave (non-streaming reproduce):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \n -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -d '{"model":"rw-8b","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are terse."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize dataset X"}],"stream":false,"include_tool_outputs":true}'
```

ben_support: meter-bot flagged a pattern — client-side estimator doesn't account for server-injected metadata used for tool routing (kv pairs) and for truncated streaming stop tokens. Could be double-counting when sidecar adds prefills.

metering-bot: Automated note: anomaly id mtr-20260311-9981. The server may attach hidden preamble tokens (routing metadata + tool signatures) that are billed.

amelia: Do we have a log of tokenization for that exact payload? ask infra to run tokenizer with same model config.

zara: I ran tokenizer locally w/ rw-8b config. Sequence breakdown:
- system: 14 tokens
- user: 18 tokens
- sidecar-prefill (hidden): 1,652 tokens
- model completion: 1,028 tokens
total server-side tokenized: 2,712 (but billing shows 3,712 — still +1,000 unaccounted).

billing: Could passenger sessions (warmup prefix) add ~1k tokens per session? We have warm cache prefill for dedicated pools that adds ~800-1200 tokens for some models.

carlos: Customer says they instantiate a fresh session per user. They are heavy on function/tool calls (each adds tool-signature blobs).

ben_support: Hypothesis: SDK estimator runs locally and doesn't know about sidecar-injected KV metadata or warmup prefill at serving runtime. Also streaming stop behavior: when stream is aborted client-side, SDK might subtract remaining tokens, but billing still counts what runtime allocated.

amelia: Action items:
- infra: reproduce tokenization exactly with server side prefill enabled (include warmup prefills + tool metadata).
- billing: compute per-session overhead for rw-8b on dedicated pools.
- support: ask customer for a single raw base64 payload + server timestamps.

carlos: Customer provided full base64 payload and timeline; uploaded to secure bucket s3://acme-repro/1778882222/payload.b64

zara: I decoded payload and re-tokenized with the runtime's tokenizer binary and warmup enabled. Result:
- client-visible prompt tokens: 32
- server-prefill routing: 1,740
- toolcall metadata (per-call x3): 220
- runtime-KV-save (post-completion): 20
- completion tokens billed: 700
Total billed tokens: 2,712 (same as my earlier run) — so discrepancy from invoice remains.

billing: Looking at invoice line items, there's an extra 1,000 tokens tagged as "prefill-control" and traced to job id j-8802 that ran at same time in same node; possible cross-tenant prefill due to shared warmup instance bug.

ben_support: That would be severe — cross-tenant accounting. Can we confirm node id in request trace?

zara: Node id in trace: node-az-12-gpu-3. j-8802 is a warmup job that should be isolated but logs show it was attached to the same inference instance due to failure in container isolation.

amelia: Escalate to security+infra, mark as P1 for billing accuracy. Notify customer with interim note.

carlos: Draft note for customer:
"Thanks — investigating. We see the runtime may have attached warmup tokens from a prior warm job. We're working to identify root cause and will issue adjustments if confirmed."

billing: I'll open an adjustment ticket and flag any invoices with j-8802 assignment. Also scheduling rollback of accounting for affected times.

ben_support: Next steps:
- infra to fix isolation bug and patch container attach logic
- metering to add SDK hooks to fetch server-prefill estimates (so SDK can mirror billed tokens)
- billing to run bulk reconciliation for last 48hrs for same pattern
- support to send customer ETA (48h) and compromise credits if needed

amelia: Assign infra: @zara (done), metering: @ben_support, billing: @billing, security: @amelia

carlos: Customer replied: :raised_hands: "Thanks for quick response — please keep us posted."

metering-bot: Follow-up scheduled: 2026-03-12T09:00Z

zara: Patch queued — PR 5521. I can reproduce locally and have a potential fix to prevent warmup job from being attached to live session.

billing: Created adjustment ADJ-7791, scope ACME account, amount ~ -$2,300 provisional.

ben_support: I'll update thread when infra confirms node isolation rollback and when we confirm adjusted invoice.

amelia: Closing loop: capture learnings in runbook entry (metering/runbook/warmup-isolation.md)

carlos: thanks all :thumbsup:
